# Gemsloot Review

> Independent, tested review of Gemsloot, a dollar-based get-paid-to (GPT) platform running since 2018. Covers legitimacy, payout proof, earning methods, referral code, and a comparison with Freecash.

This is a single-page site (gemsloot.win). All content below lives on the one page at https://gemsloot.win/.

## Key facts

- Overall rating: 4.2/5
- Gemsloot is a legitimate GPT (get-paid-to) platform, founded in 2018, earnings tracked directly in US dollars (no points system)
- Trustpilot rating: 4.1–4.4 across thousands of reviews
- Earning methods: game offers ($10–40), app installs ($0.50–5), surveys ($0.10–2), referrals (tiered lifetime commission, 15% at the author's current Tier 7)
- Cashout methods: PayPal, cryptocurrency, gift cards
- Minimum withdrawal: $0.50
- Referral code: cheswick (signup link: https://gemsloot.com/?aff=cheswick&trk=1769)
- Compared against Freecash: Gemsloot has a lower minimum withdrawal ($0.50 vs $5, Freecash up to $20 in some regions) and faster crypto payouts (under 30 min when tested vs within 24h), but fewer offer walls (8+ vs 10+) and a slightly lower Trustpilot rating (4.1–4.4 vs 4.3–4.6)
